E2907

Performance budget `{name}` regressed / is inconclusive

What

Performance budget `{name}` regressed / is inconclusive

Why

The shared evaluator's estimator and confidence bounds do not prove the declared limit.

Fix

Improve the measured behavior, inspect the named evidence, or record an explicit exception.
